_comment: Acquisition settings destination of the Settings hub, as the Qt AcquisitionSettingsWidget (output folder, advanced, device type, simulator parameters). Drawn by emtk.view_form over AcquisitionSettingsModel (gui/acq_app.py). The simulator's per-species table, kinetics matrices, decay editor and channel switches are Qt-only sections (see deliberate.json).
title: Acquisition

sections.name: settings
sections.title: Acquisition
sections.description: Acquisition settings.

sections.title: Output
sections.description: Where new measurements are written.

sections.label: Folder
sections.description: Standard folder for new measurements. Written to gui.acquisition.output_path on every change.

buttons.label: Browse...
buttons.description: Pick the standard output folder from a folder chooser.

sections.title: Advanced Configuration
sections.description: Chunking and pacing of the photon stream.

sections.label: Chunk Size
sections.description: Number of photons to read per chunk (each photon = 32 bits).

sections.label: Real-time Sim
sections.description: Pace simulation to roughly 1 s wall time = 1 s sim time. Only for the Simulation device.

sections.title: Device Configuration
sections.description: Hardware selection and the device's own parameters.

sections.label: Active Device Type
sections.description: Which acquisition hardware (or the simulator) the Acquisition tool uses.

sections.text: No specific configuration is edited here for this device type. Its card setup dialog (vendor settings) opens from the Acquisition tool.
sections.description: Vendor devices keep their own setup dialog.

sections.title: Acquisition
sections.description: Excitation and file splitting of the simulated stream.

sections.label: Mode
sections.description: Excitation mode: CW (continuous) or Pulsed (pulsed laser; enables the micro-time / TCSPC axis).

sections.label: Photons
sections.description: Total number of photons to simulate.

sections.label: Photons/file
sections.description: Split the streamed SPC output into files of this many photons each.

sections.label: Output folder
sections.description: Folder where SPC/photon-stream files are written.

sections.label: Diffusion seed
sections.description: Seed of the diffusion random number generator.

sections.label: Emission seed
sections.description: Seed of the emission random number generator.

sections.title: Sample & brightness
sections.description: Species, channels and brightness of the simulated sample.
Read-only summary of the stored sample definition.

sections.title: Geometry
sections.description: Simulation box, focus and time step.

sections.label: Box XY
sections.description: Lateral box size (um).

sections.label: Box Z
sections.description: Axial box size (um).

sections.label: Focus w0
sections.description: Lateral focus waist (um).

sections.label: Focus z0
sections.description: Axial focus extent (um).

sections.label: Step
sections.description: Simulation time step (ms).

sections.title: Microtime
sections.description: TAC axis of the simulated detector.

sections.label: TAC channels
sections.description: Number of TAC (micro-time) channels.

sections.label: TAC dt
sections.description: Width of one TAC channel (ns).

sections.label: Laser period
sections.description: Laser repetition period (ns).

sections.title: Performance
sections.description: Optional throughput knobs of the native Sim* engine. Defaults reproduce the exact fixed-step engine.

sections.label: Coasting
sections.description: Skip steps while a molecule is far from the focus.

sections.label: Two-step field lookup
sections.description: Look up the field in two steps (bounding box first).

sections.label: Independent molecules
sections.description: Treat molecules as independent.

sections.label: Analytic Gaussian focus
sections.description: Use the analytic Gaussian excitation.

sections.label: PSF / focus model
sections.description: Point-spread function / focus model.

sections.label: Rayleigh range zR (um)
sections.description: Rayleigh range of the Gaussian-Lorentzian model.

sections.label: PSF file (radial)
sections.description: Measured radial PSF table (radial model only).

sections.label: PSF r step (um)
sections.description: Radial step of the PSF table.

sections.label: PSF z step (um)
sections.description: Axial step of the PSF table.
